steps.note: Open the Single Stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ with lot-level awarding.
Provide the required event title before publishing.
Apply the first available RFQ template so the product sheet is rendered.
Add the requested CYLINDER product with quantity 10.
Populate the pricing sheet after adding the product.
Verify the product's default variant was filled automatically.
Verify the requested quantity is present in the sheet.
Set the first product's delivery location.
Commit a valid event schedule required for publishing.
Invite one available QA vendor so the event can be published and the template can include a vendor column.
Confirm the browser reached the published event page.

args.goal: On the published RFQ stage, locate and click the bid template download control, then leave the screen after the bid template download has completed.

steps.note: Use the buyer-side screen to perform the catalog action that has no dedicated domain step.
Confirm that the bid template file was downloaded.
